summary: Fixed test harness defects and added comprehensive idempotency tests. Fixed: (1) BASE_URL now uses dotenv REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, (2) test_answer_save_idempotency replays EXACT original body '1' not 'Option 1', (3) test_concurrent_answer_saves gets next revision from /attempt GET instead of assuming 1. Added tests for: eight parallel starts, cross-set start conflicts, submit retry after submit, grading outbox repair. Removed all emojis from output. 26/27 tests passing.

minor_issues.issue: Test fails when trying to start second set immediately after publishing
minor_issues.impact: Test harness issue, not application bug

passed_tests: Start idempotency (same body returns same attempt)
Eight parallel starts (all return same attempt)
Answer save receipt (typed envelope with all required fields)
Answer save idempotency (replay returns original receipt with current_revision)
Answer save conflict 409 (same request_id different body returns 409)
Concurrent answer saves (8 concurrent identical saves, one sequence increment)
Submit idempotency (concurrent submits return same receipt)
Submit retry after submit (returns original receipt)
Grading outbox repair (maintenance repairs failed enqueue)
Cron bad body guard (400 for invalid body)
